items.author: Linda M. Eyer
items.title: Not for me
items.content: They take up too much space for my small and shallow drawers.

items.author: Amazon Customer
items.title: Pricey organizer
items.content: Does the job of separating things in the drawers. Whenever you open the drawer it slides around, pricey for what it is though.

items.author: Suzie Andreas Jackson
items.title: Manufacter Out To Lunch
items.content: This product was termed to be just bamboo. This kitchen organizer had some sort of laminate on the bottom. Laminates can't be trusted since they may give off fumes that are unhealthy. I asked them what it was and never got an answer back. I'd purchased so many, I didn't send it back, because no description from a manufacturer can ever be trusted. They leave out details that may interfere with a sale. People want to know exactly every piece, part, and chemical that goes into their products. No manufacturer is ever 100% honest with the details of a product. Sorry, that's my honest opinion.

items.author: Christina
items.title: As described but doesn’t stay in place
items.content: I would like to see small pieces of bamboo to allow you to keep the slots in place once you decide the width. They keep moving when you open and close the drawer which drive me nuts. I’m trying to get my husband to cut some pieces of wood to stabilize the size of each drawer. It also slides front to back so I don’t like that either. Maybe a little more attention to the customization aspect would be nice.

items.author: roxycowgirl
items.title: Not the best for silverware
items.content: It fit well in my drawer, but the dividers weren’t as helpful as k was hoping for.  There aren’t enough to separate your steak knives from butter knives there also isn’t a place for serving spoons and forks.  It’s also significantly longer than the silverware so it shifts every time you open and close it.  With teenagers, it always looks like a wreck.  It looks nice and would be better suited for a junk drawer in opinion.  It seems made well enough too.  It just wasn’t ideal for me and I’ll be shopping for a different style.
